description: Returns the current price and links of ONE partner offer that search_offers returned before. USE WHEN you need to re-check the price of an offer from an earlier search_offers result. Do not use it to search – use search_offers. PARAMETERS: "id" = externalId from search_offers, or "url" = the product URL. EXAMPLE: {"id":"<externalId>"}. RETURNS: the same structure as search_offers with at most one entry in products[] (empty if the offer is gone).

language.description: Language of the linked pages (ISO 639-1, e.g. "de", "en", "tr", "ar", "fr"). Set it to the user's language. Default: Accept-Language header, otherwise "de"; unsupported languages fall back to "en".

name: lookup_product

facets.description: Verfuegbare Filter-Werte (Marke + domain-spezifische Attribute) mit Trefferzahlen — zum gezielten Nachfiltern via query/brand/minPrice/maxPrice.

attributes.description: Domain-spezifische Filter-Attribute, z.B. {farbe, watt, speicher, reichweite}.

title: Look up one partner offer on wosolar.de
